method.operation: ScriptHost::run_tick over real Rust ECS Velocity and PhysicsPose columns through generated C# query
method.validation: Every row checked for exact velocity/pose float bits, unchanged angular velocity/rotation, common write changed tick, and unchanged initial added tick; paired checksums match.
method.heat: Cold lane sets module hot=false and emits optimized Release IL; hot lane sets hot=true and emits Debug IL for EnC, reported separately.
method.timed_region: Fixed tick only; module compile/load, row creation, full readback, JSON output and shutdown excluded.
method.allocator: Rust global allocation count/requested bytes across all process threads; includes existing task-pool/scope allocations, excludes managed allocations. New stamp metadata uses persistent reusable scratch.
method.setup_harness_change: After baseline build, setup-only modulo predicates became equivalent is_multiple_of calls to satisfy clippy; measured kernel/timing loop unchanged.
method.scope: Dense table-backed native columns. Sparse marker archetypes covered by tests; sparse data/filter support is a pre-existing separate limitation.
